messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "male hormone"
set: ["male hormone", "hormone therapy", "GLP-1 hormone", "blocks male hormones", "blocking male hormones", "male sexual dysfunction", "male baby development", "male offspring development", "gut hormone receptors", "risk to male baby", "low adrenal hormone levels", "blocking action of male hormones", "blocking effect of male hormones", "may feminize male offspring development", "acts like body's stress hormone", "thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in blood"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
